newsitem.title: CANADA: Orvana reports Bolivia drill results.
newsitem.headline: Orvana reports Bolivia drill results.

text.p: Orvana Minerals Corp said on Monday that drilling at its Bolivia gold project shows an increase in potential mineralization.
Orvana reported results from five holes at the Pampa zone at its 50-percent owned Pederson project in Peru.
The results showed mineralization occurs beyond the northeast trending fault previously thought to be the northern boundary of the zone, the company said in a statement.
"This means that the deposit is unbounded under the gravels to the north and west," the company said.
Orvana said gold grades are increasing and mineralized intercepts are thickening to the northwest.
Gold grades ranged from 1.1 grams of gold per tonne to 4.7 grams per tonne, with thicknesses from three metres to 64 metres.
The company has reported assays from 14 holes on the property so far. Results for 36 more holes are pending, the Orvana said.
